description: List the anchored JIDEC verification paths (most recent first), with purpose, verdict and Bitcoin anchoring status.
name: jidec_list_paths

count.description: How many anchored paths the ledger returned. 0 means the ledger answered and holds none. It never means the ledger could not be read, that is an error.

lookup.description: ok = the ledger was read and the record exists. absent = the ledger was read and there is no such record. A read that FAILED never appears here: it comes back as a tool error (isError: true), so a consumer can never mistake this server's own failure for a statement about the ledger's contents.

title: List anchored verification paths
